title: 요추 MRI
text:
L-spine MRI (non-enhanced)
임상: LBP with Rt leg radiating pain.

판독소견:
L4-5: central to Rt subarticular disc protrusion → Rt L5 nerve root compression.
L5-S1: mild disc bulging, neural foraminal stenosis 없음.
Vertebral body marrow signal 정상.
Incidental: Lt kidney lower pole 2.5 cm T2 homogeneous hyperintense, thin wall lesion → simple cyst (Bosniak I) 가능성 높음. f/u 불필요.

결론:
1. L4-5 disc protrusion with Rt L5 root compression.
2. Lt renal simple cyst (incidental).
teaches: Normal report: simple renal cyst, explicit 'f/u 불필요'.
